sample_unit: ChatGPT-4o responses (30 per each of 30 orthopantomograms)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT-4o responses across 30 repeated runs per radiograph
links.effect: Percentage agreement among repeated responses was 82.7%, but Gwet's coefficient of agreement was 60.4%, suggesting only moderate repeatability.
links.quote: The percentage agreement among repeated responses was 82.7 %, indicating high consistency, though Gwet's coefficient of agreement (60.4 %) suggested only moderate repeatability.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4o interpretation of orthopantomograms for third molar assessment
links.effect: Accuracy was 38.44% (95% CI 35.27%-41.62%); responses frequently incomplete or fabricated, insufficient for unsupervised clinical use.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o achieved an accuracy rate of 38.44 % (95 % CI: 35.27 %-41.62 %).

screen.reason: The study empirically assesses the accuracy and reproducibility of GPT-4o on dental panoramic radiographs without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail.
